name: Benunskilled
cooked:
Thanks, the timeline is very helpful. Your last /Sat0shi:31.0.0/ on Sep 22 matches my node, when the same addresses switched to /Satoshi:31.0.0/

On the CVE reboots: I’m not sure they explain the stop, at least on my node. From Oct 16 the fleet only reached me from 8 AWS addresses, and AWS said EC2 was not affected and needed no action (2026-137-AWS). The last sessions from all 8 closed within about a minute (13:27–13:28 UTC on Oct 18), spread over 6 AWS regions on three continents. Host reboots across six regions at the same moment seem unlikely to me, and none of the fleet came back from any address since, so it looks more like something central on the operator’s side. That could still be a reboot, e.g. if their controller ran at one of the providers that did restart, so I can’t rule your idea out.

Looking forward to your post on the compact block side!
